verdict.rationale: MX exposes a broad Platform API (aggregation, verification, balances, statements, webhooks) with an OpenAPI spec and SDKs, and the Client Dashboard also has API-key management, suggesting most functions are API-accessible. However, some dashboard-only features (SSO SAML setup, user lookup UI, mobile maintenance mode toggles, webhook creation via dashboard UI) are documented as dashboard actions without a clearly confirmed equivalent API endpoint, and there's no explicit statement of full UI/API parity. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or evidence that dashboard-only admin functions (SSO config, user lookup, mobile maintenance mode) are also exposed via API, independent confirmation of full coverage.
